metadata.description: Archive multiple properties for a specified object type within a given app.
metadata.learn_more: Archive multiple properties for a specified object type within a given app. This endpoint is useful for managing large sets of properties that are no longer needed or should be hidden from active use. It requires specifying the app ID and object type in the path parameters.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the properties are being archived. This is a required path parameter.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of object whose properties are to be archived. This is a required path parameter.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: An array of property names to be processed in the batch operation. Each item in the array is expected to be a string representing a property name.
